verdict_rule: CLOSE if |delta| <= tolerance; MODERATE if <= 2x tolerance; OFF beyond. Delta = camera - sensor session mean. Deltas from unrounded values.
discriminates_rule: a test is discriminating when the sensor envelope SD (n = 3) is narrower than the tolerance; provisional at n = 3
back_foot_contact: withheld on every clip (ADR-0020): no selector reproduced frame-adjudicated contact on 0 of 3 clips

sensor_sampling_rate_hz.status: inferred from run-up stride cadence; not confirmed by the manufacturer; all millisecond figures depend on it
